visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair tied back in a half-ponytail walks towards the camera on an outdoor city sidewalk. She wears a white crop top, dark grey trousers, and an unbuttoned pink-and-white vertical striped shirt. She carries a pink quilted shoulder bag adorned with a plush dog keychain. The background shows residential gates, parked scooters, and green plants under natural daylight. (2) She stops and turns to face the camera, smiling while adjusting her bag. She gestures towards the small size of the bag while interacting with someone off-screen. (3) She opens her bag and begins removing items to show the camera: a bundle of keys with a white plush dog, a black smartphone, a red lipstick tube, a small pink round compact mirror, a grey hair scrunchie, and a black designer cardholder wallet. (4) She triumphantly pulls out a thin, golden-beige electronic device. The scene transitions to an indoor studio setting with a white background where she holds the white device in front of her face. (5) Close-up shots of the device (momoBOOK) follow, showing its silver metallic back and incredibly thin 3.2mm side profile being measured between two fingers. (6) The video cuts to an office desk setup with a large computer monitor. The device is on a stand, showing a drawing of a pug. A hand adjusts a slider on the screen to change the lighting from cool white to warm amber. (7) The scene shifts back outdoors to a wooden park bench where the woman sits reading with the device in a brown folding case. (8) Close-up interface shots show a library of book covers and a digital store menu. (9) She holds two new protective cases in front of the camera—one in muted blue and one in soft pink. (10) The final shot returns to the indoor setting where she holds the device and smiles warmly at the viewer.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a conversational dialogue between two young women. The primary voice is clear, high-energy, and friendly, accompanied by light acoustic pop BGM with a steady guitar strumming pattern and moderate tempo. (2) As the main creator handles her bag, the sound of keys jingling and items rustling within the bag is clearly audible against the conversational speech. (3) A magical 'sparkle' SFX and a high-pitched 'Tada!' vocal sound effect mark the reveal of the e-reader, triggering a shift into a more structured, narrative speech style. (4) During the product review portion, the narration becomes more professional and enunciated, while digital UI SFX (soft dings) punctuate mentions of specific technical features like the 32-level lighting system. (5) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound effect is used to bridge the indoor and outdoor scenes. The BGM remains consistent in volume and tempo throughout the entire track, providing a cheerful and cohesive background.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem/Contradiction -> Solution/Product Intro -> Feature Deep Dive -> Conclusion/CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the momoBOOK e-reader by framing it as a solution for readers who want portability without sacrificing content variety. It uses a popular 'what's in my bag' social media format to create a hook about carrying 'five books' in a tiny bag, then transitions into a technical review that emphasizes the device's light weight, thin profile, eye-friendly screen, and new color options.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of product features, brand logo 'momoBOOK' displayed prominently on screen and mentioned repeatedly in speech and subtitles.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively bridges lifestyle content and tech review by using a relatable daily scenario (carrying a bag) to introduce the product's value proposition.
